explanation: Faithful negative resolution, matching Turjányi's counterexample. A is an asymptotic additive basis of some finite order, A(N) = o(N), and the formal statement denies that |(A+A)∩[1,N]| / |A∩[1,N]| → ∞ holds for every such A. Real division by 0 for small N is irrelevant to Tendsto atTop. Using an asymptotic basis is the right reading.
